name: io.github.a32116150-ctrl/verify402-mcp
title: verify402
description: Token safety check for AI agents before they swap: quote-based sellability, $0.02/call, free gate.

environmentVariables.name: VERIFY402_URL
environmentVariables.description: verify402 base URL. Default https://vex402.online, the live mainnet service. The public Base Sepolia demo was retired on 2026-11-19; there is no public testnet endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key for a dedicated hot wallet. Omit and the seven paid tools refuse with a clear error (the free tools still work). verify402-mcp@3.6.0 (this published release) defaults paid calls to Base mainnet (eip155:8453) — real USDC, $0.02-$0.10 per call, capped by MAX_PAYMENT_USD. The public Base Sepolia testnet demo (eip155:84532) was retired on 2026-11-19; there is no public testnet endpoint. Never use a main wallet.

environmentVariables.name: VERIFY402_NETWORKS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated EVM payment networks for paid calls. Default Base mainnet (eip155:8453), real USDC; eip155:84532 (Base Sepolia) is no longer a public endpoint; the demo was retired on 2026-11-19. The supported network-to-canonical-asset map is constrained to Base mainnet and Base Sepolia.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_PAYMENT_USD
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on one x402 payment in USD (default 0.25). Enforced before signing.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_DAILY_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional cap for total spend per UTC day across restarts.
